title: Cambridge Fetal Thymus Dissociation
author: Jongeun Park

steps_raw.instruction: Fetal thymus dissociation protocol
digestion solution: 5ml PBS + 100ul Librase TH (2.5mg/ml stock, 50X, final 50ug/ml)
stop solution: 2% FBS in PBS (40ml PBS + 800ul FBS)
cell stock solution: 1.8ml FBS + 200ul DMSO
Cryovials and Mr. Frosty
Prepare hood (wipe with 70% EtOH)
Place tissue onto petri dish (in the hood)
Remove any attached fat or impurities
Mince tissue with scalpel
Put minced tissue into 15ml falcon tube filled with 5ml digestion solution
Do not use pipet tips as this can be sticky
Use scalpel to carry minced tissue
Wash scalpel with digestion solution to put all remaining tissue into the falcon tube
Incubate for 37’C for 30min (water bath)
in case large mesh is still visible
take sup. and do further digestion with tissue leftover by adding 4ml 0.25% Trypsin solution to 1ml tissue + previous digestion solution
incubate another 20-30min
Add 5ml stop solution to 5ml dissociated tissue + digestion solution
Filter through 40um strainer
Spin down, 750g, 5min, 4’C
Carefully remove supernatant
If resulting pellet is red:
add 2ml 1X RBC lysis buffer (00-4300-54)
Top up with 20ml stop solution (2% FBS in PBS)
filter through 40um strainer
Count cells to determine resuspension volume
Spin down, 750g, 5min, 4’C
Carefully remove supernatant
Resuspend pellet into appropriate amount of PBS (based on cell counting)
1 more wash with stop solution, count and resuspend
Count and load onto 10X
Freeze all remaining cells using cell stock solution
